description: This file defines the ActivitiesParseRule class, a subclass of BaseRule, which implements pre-parsing and panel parsing logic for activity-related panels in the SuiteCRM application. It adjusts field names based on view context and content matching.

classes.name: ActivitiesParseRule
classes.description: A class extending BaseRule that provides custom parsing logic for activity panels, including field remapping based on view type and cleanup of specific fields.

methods.name: preParse
methods.description: Modifies panels by renaming certain fields based on view type ('DetailView') and pattern matching, such as converting 'duration_minutes' to 'duration_hours' and 'time_start' to 'date_start'.

methods.name: parsePanels
methods.description: Iterates through panels to clear the 'duration_minutes' field values when matched.
